WHAT_AN_OBSERVATION_IS: price_id is a stable composite key, so the same market at two capture times is two observations of one market and no name matching is needed.
SAME_PASS_MINUTES: DECLARED. Rows inside one scrape carry their own moments minutes apart -- the one board on disk spans 8.5 minutes end to end -- so two rows closer together than this are the same pass and not movement.
NEVER: no projection is adjusted toward a price by this module, and it holds no code path that could. Comparison runs one way only.
